name: Deskly
summary: A modern help desk agent workspace, like Zendesk or Freshdesk: ticket views with live counts and SLA countdowns, a ticket with its properties, the conversation, a reply composer with macros and internal notes, the customer's orders, and a knowledge base.
features: Ticket views (yours, unassigned, urgent and high, breaching first-reply target, pending, recently solved) with live counts
SLA countdowns and breached flags, sortable queue
Ticket properties: priority, type, group, status
Tags from a set list, added by typing
Conversation history with customer, agent and internal note messages
Reply composer: public reply or internal note, with status on send
Macros that fill the reply with the customer's first name
Customer card: plan, customer since, location, orders, other tickets, note
Extra ticket fields with set options
Issue a refund (order, amount, method, reason)
Create an engineering issue (title, steps, expected, actual, severity)
Live chat with a customer, asked from a question library, with a cause to pick
